item.title: Unapriled be thy fools
item.description: We at sosumitech greatly value ours user's experience. After receiving tons of feedback from our valued netizens, we have decided to roll back the update released yesterday on the 1st of April. Unfortunately, due to the wasted 300 million dollar investment in research and development required to develop this technology, sosumitech will cease being a corporate entity immediately. Website operations will continue as usual.

item.title: sosumi.xyz is finally in full color now!
item.description: After one whole year operating in black and white mode, our engineers at sosumitech have finally cracked the code to displaying all your favorite pages in brilliant, vibrant colors! The future is now, and it's in color.

item.title: Minor fixes and more slop
item.description: Added a new blobslop comic, fixed some image scaling issues with /oekakish/ and finally added more stuff to the good images gallery.

item.title: Spring cleaning! (Even though it's autumn here...)
item.description: A bunch of small updates to generally improve UX throughout.

item.title: Reimplemented blog to now use SSI
item.description: I decided to ditch Zoner in favor of Nekoweb's new SSI feature for Interrobang. This makes managing the blog MUCH easier in the long run.

item.title: Reimplemented "News" section
item.description: Switched the news section to an embed of the site's RSS over the manual setup it used in the past. Update reports should work more seamlessly now!

item.title: Happy new year! Have some very minor updates!
